description: This Java source file defines an Android activity demonstrating the use of a content provider with throttled data loading, including database setup, content provider implementation, and a list fragment with data population and clearing options.

classes.name: LoaderThrottle
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating content provider with throttling and database setup.

classes.name: MainTable
classes.description: Defines database table schema and content URI for the main data table.

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: SQLiteOpenHelper subclass managing database creation and upgrade.

classes.name: SimpleProvider
classes.description: ContentProvider implementation for CRUD operations on the main table.

classes.name: ThrottledLoaderListFragment
classes.description: ListFragment with loader to display data, with options to populate and clear database, using throttled loading.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and adds the list fragment.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader with a 2-second update throttle.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Swaps cursor in adapter and shows list.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes the database helper.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database upgrade by dropping and recreating the table.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles query requests to the content provider.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts new data into the database via content provider.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes data from the database via content provider.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates data in the database via content provider.
